description: Given a Prefect dbt integration (DbtCoreOperation, ShellOperation running dbt CLI, or DbtCloudJob), author the matching Orchestra pipeline YAML — DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE for dbt Core, DBT/DBT_RUNJOB for dbt Cloud — consolidating a commands list into a semicolon-joined string and carrying project_dir/package_manager over as real task parameters, including a project pinned to a Python version other than the default.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect dbt flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_core_operation_poetry.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task whose commands consolidate the seed, run --select tag:daily --target prod, and test --select tag:daily calls into one semicolon-joined string ('dbt seed; dbt run --select tag:daily --target prod; dbt test --select tag:daily;'), package_manager: POETRY (from the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal), and project_dir: dbt_project.

assertions.text: commands includes the seed step
commands includes the selective, targeted run step
commands includes the selective test step
package_manager is set to POETRY based on the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal in the source comment
project_dir is carried over as 'dbt_project', matching DbtCoreOperation(project_dir="dbt_project")
The three list items passed to DbtCoreOperation(commands=[...]) are consolidated into a single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task's semicolon-joined commands string rather than split into three separate tasks

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_shell_operation_build.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task (ShellOperation running dbt CLI is treated identically to DbtCoreOperation) with commands: 'dbt build --select tag:nightly;', project_dir set to 'transform' (from the working_dir), and package_manager flagged with a # MANUAL: comment since no lockfile/requirements.txt is visible anywhere in the source to infer PIP/POETRY/UV.

assertions.text: The build command with its --select flag is preserved in commands
project_dir is carried over as 'transform', matching ShellOperation(working_dir="transform")
package_manager is flagged with a MANUAL comment for the user to confirm, rather than silently defaulting to PIP with no supporting signal

The ShellOperation(commands=["dbt build ..."]) call is converted to integration DBT_CORE / integration_job DBT_CORE_EXECUTE exactly as if it had been a DbtCoreOperation, not treated as a generic shell/Python task

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_cloud_job_trigger.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single task with integration: DBT and integration_job: DBT_RUNJOB (the dbt Cloud pair, not DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE), parameters.job_id: '987654' carried over from DbtCloudJob(job_id=987654), with account_id (54321) represented on the dbt Cloud connection rather than as a task parameter.

assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
The task uses the DBT integration (dbt Cloud pair), not DBT_CORE
The task runs the DBT_RUNJOB job
job_id 987654 is carried over into parameters.job_id
account_id (54321) is not invented as a task parameter — it belongs on the dbt Cloud connection, not duplicated in parameters
No DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task is produced for this dbt Cloud job — the Cloud and Core integration pairs are not conflated

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_build_snowflake_block_env.py), and say how the Snowflake credentials the dbt project needs should reach it. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live warehouse access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task, plus guidance that the existing Snowflake connection is *linked* on the dbt Core connection (Linked connections) rather than its account/user/password being copied into that connection's Secrets or left in the YAML. profiles.yml then reads the injected <INTEGRATION>__<CONNECTION_ID>__<FIELD> variables via dbt's env_var() — e.g. SNOWFLAKE__PROD_12345__SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD — and must not assume a variable is present, since a deleted or undecryptable linked connection is skipped silently.

assertions.text: The warehouse credentials behind the 'snowflake-prod' Prefect SnowflakeCredentials block feeding DbtCoreOperation.env are reached by linking that existing Snowflake connection on the dbt Core connection, rather than being copied into the dbt Core connection's own Secrets

Linked credentials are read in profiles.yml through dbt's env_var() using the <INTEGRATION>__<CONNECTION_ID>__<FIELD> naming (parts joined by a double underscore, <FIELD> being the field ID from the integration's Authentication parameters table), e.g. SNOWFLAKE__PROD_12345__SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD
No Snowflake account, user or password value is written into the YAML

The conversion does not assume a linked credential's environment variable is present — a linked connection that has been deleted, or whose credentials cannot be decrypted, is skipped silently, so its variables are simply absent

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect dbt flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_core_operation_py313.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task with parameters.python_version: '3.13' — carried over from the project's .python-version / requires-python pin rather than downgraded to the '3.12' default, since 3.13 is a supported dbt Core Task version — plus package_manager: UV from the uv.lock signal, project_dir: analytics, and commands: 'dbt build --select tag:nightly;'.

assertions.text: parameters.python_version is '3.13', not silently downgraded to the '3.12' default
package_manager is UV, inferred from the uv.lock signal
project_dir is carried over as 'analytics'
The project's pinned 3.13 is treated as a supported dbt Core Task Python version and carried over, rather than being flagged as unsupported or rewritten to 3.12
